name: Rempart Leonhardt
original_name: ランパール・レオンハルト
source:
"Everything is for the glory of her majesty, the Queen!"

A soldier in the British Army, his magnificent beard is only equaled by his strong sense of justice and national pride. Although he does his best to advance the cause of his queen and country, his over exuberance often makes his hard work for naught.
He also holds a very personal and deep-seated grudge against Lupin.

[Taken from [url=http://aksysgames.com/code-realize/]the official website[/url]]
